changes: Completed physical retirement of active Authority Server vocabulary/code surfaces: added the retirement contract, cleaned active user-facing wording to local assurance/admissibility, removed active authority command exposure, quarantined server-backed legacy paths, added the retired-vocabulary validation guard, and fixed scoped review-pass supersession so stale pass receipts do not keep blocking after a fresh lane pass.
usage: Use local assurance/admissibility surfaces and commands; run node packages/main/dist/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js or lattice validate to enforce the retired Authority vocabulary guard before DONE.
expectedOutcome: Active CLI/docs/help/runtime surfaces no longer present Authority Server completion semantics, while local proof/admissibility/receipt-bundle workflows continue to validate and DONE gates require local evidence plus 3x2 host quorum when high-risk review signals appear.
actualTranscript: Observed TEST PASS with 31 configured validation commands, DONE-required PASS including packages/main build and root npm test, delivery-check PASS, and quorum_submit emitted 3 rounds x 2 hosts using codex-cli plus claude-code-cli with review escalation ok=true and assuranceLevel full-3x2.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible acceptance gap remains; the final result matches the expected local assurance/admissibility outcome. The only discovered extra work was a scoped review-pass supersession bug, fixed and covered by flow-stability smoke.
